title: The Gate Beneath the City
summary: Ha-Jun dives 1,000 meters down the vertical Gehenna Chasm into Section 9, battling swarms of void crawlers through the destroyed underground laboratory to reach Tae-Jun's stasis wing.

panels.shot: freefall down the vertical chasm wide shot
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges straight down through the violet-glowing chasm, wind roaring past his ears at terminal velocity.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun plunges straight down through the violet-glowing chasm, wind roaring past his ears at terminal velocity.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bangni-chamakdar khai se sidhe neeche girta hai, hawa uske kanon ke paas se tej gati se gujarti hai.

panels.shot: kuro gliding alongside as shadow stabilizer
panels.action: Kuro glides three feet away, his shadow feathers buffering the turbulence: 'Landing sequence ready karo!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Section 9 ka ceiling 200 meter niche hai! Brace for impact!

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides three feet away, his shadow feathers buffering the turbulence: 'Landing sequence ready karo!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro teen feet door fisalta hai, uski chhaya pankh ashanti ko rokti hai: 'landing sequence taiyar karo!'.

panels.shot: shattered concrete bunker ceiling approaching
panels.action: A massive reinforced bunker roof with twisted rebar and broken warning lights looms into view.
panels.prose_en: A massive reinforced bunker roof with twisted rebar and broken warning lights looms into view.
panels.prose_hi: Mudi hui sariya aur tuti hui chetavani roshni ke saath ek vishal prabalit bunker chhat drishya mein dikhai deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating blood cushion beneath boots
panels.action: Ha-Jun channels the Ring of Hollow Blood, generating a six-foot pressurized cushion of liquid blood below his soles.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun channels the Ring of Hollow Blood, generating a six-foot pressurized cushion of liquid blood below his soles.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ring off hollow blood ko prasarit karta hai, jisse uske talvon ke neeche taral khoon ka chhah foot ka dabaavyukt kushan utpann hota hai.

panels.shot: three-point impact landing inside bunker
panels.action: Ha-Jun smashes through the ceiling hole into Sub-Level 3, the blood cushion absorbing the entire 10-ton kinetic shock.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smashes through the ceiling hole into Sub-Level 3, the blood cushion absorbing the entire 10-ton kinetic shock.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun chhat ke chhed ke madhyam se up-star 3 mein ghus jata hai, khoon kushan poore 10-tan gatij jhatke ko avshoshit kar leta hai.

panels.shot: dust clearing to reveal destroyed bio-lab
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands up: an apocalyptic labyrinth of shattered cylindrical glass tanks, green bio-fluid flooding the floor.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands up: an apocalyptic labyrinth of shattered cylindrical glass tanks, green bio-fluid flooding the floor.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khada hai: toote hue belanakar kaanch ke tankon ki ek sarvanashakari bhulbhulaiya, farsh par hare jaiv-taral padarth ki badh.

panels.shot: red emergency klaxons flashing in steam
panels.action: Dim red strobe lights flash through venting steam: 'WARNING: CONTAINMENT BREACH IN SECTOR 7'.
panels.prose_en: Dim red strobe lights flash through venting steam: 'WARNING: CONTAINMENT BREACH IN SECTOR 7'.
panels.prose_hi: Dhundhali lal strobe lightein bahar nikalne wali bhaap ke madhyam se chamakti han: 'chetavni: sector 7 mein niyantran ullanghan'.

panels.shot: ha-jun wiping dust from collar
panels.action: Ha-Jun checks his earpiece: 'Min-Jae, main Section 9 mein land ho chuka hoon. Map data relay karo.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main Sub-Level 3 par hoon. Bhai ka cryo-pod kahan hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun checks his earpiece: 'Min-Jae, main Section 9 mein land ho chuka hoon. Map data relay karo.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna yearpis check karta hai: 'min-je, main section 9 mein land ho chuka hun. map data relay karo.'

panels.shot: min-jae voice on earpiece
panels.action: Min-Jae's voice crackles through satellite static: 'Sub-Level 7, Vault 09! Elevator shafts destroyed hain, stairwell use karo!'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Sub-Level 7 jao! Wahan thermal readings off the charts hain!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae's voice crackles through satellite static: 'Sub-Level 7, Vault 09! Elevator shafts destroyed hain, stairwell use karo!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ki awaz satellite static ke madhyam se gunjati hai: 'sab-leval 7, walt 09! lift ke shaft nasht ho gaye han, sidhi ka upyog karo!'.

panels.shot: chittering sounds in ventilation pipes
panels.action: Rapid, metallic skittering echoes from inside the overhead air conditioning ducts.
panels.prose_en: Rapid, metallic skittering echoes from inside the overhead air conditioning ducts.
panels.prose_hi: Overhed air conditioning nalikaon ke andar se tej, dhatvik chheentein goonjati han.

panels.shot: swarms of abyssal void crawlers dropping
panels.action: Dozens of three-foot insectoid Abyssal Void Crawlers drop from the ceiling, their razor-mandibles dripping venom.
panels.prose_en: Dozens of three-foot insectoid Abyssal Void Crawlers drop from the ceiling, their razor-mandibles dripping venom.
panels.prose_hi: Darjanon teen foot ke kitbhakshi abisal void croller chhat se girte han, unke rager-mandibles se jahar tapakta hai.

panels.shot: crawlers lunging with venomous pincers
panels.action: Five crawlers leap simultaneously at Ha-Jun's face and throat from multiple angles.
panels.prose_en: Five crawlers leap simultaneously at Ha-Jun's face and throat from multiple angles.
panels.prose_hi: Panch croller kai konon se Ha-Jun ke chehre aur gale par ek saath chhalang lagate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting dual bloodfire katanas
panels.action: Ha-Jun's blades ignite in violet-crimson glory with zero delay, spinning into a double-helix of flame.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's blades ignite in violet-crimson glory with zero delay, spinning into a double-helix of flame.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke blade shunya vilamb ke saath bangni-lal rang ki mahima mein prajvalit hote han, lau ke duble-helix mein ghumte han.

panels.shot: clean cross-slashes bisecting crawlers
panels.action: In three lightning-fast fluid strokes, all five crawlers are cleanly cleaved in midair, dissolving into purple ash.
panels.prose_en: In three lightning-fast fluid strokes, all five crawlers are cleanly cleaved in midair, dissolving into purple ash.
panels.prose_hi: Teen bijli-tej taral stroke men, sabhi paanch croller hawa mein saf-saf saaf ho jaate han, baingani raakh mein ghul jaate han.

panels.shot: kuro incinerating survivors with shadow fire
panels.action: Kuro unleashes a stream of black-violet dragon breath from his beak, incinerating twenty crawlers in the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: In kido-makodo par waqt barbad mat karo! Aage badho!

panels.prose_en: Kuro unleashes a stream of black-violet dragon breath from his beak, incinerating twenty crawlers in the hallway.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apni chonch se kale-bangni dragon ki sanson ki ek dhara nikali, jisse dalan mein bees croller bhasm ho gaye.

panels.shot: ha-jun sprinting through blast doors
panels.action: Ha-Jun vaults over burning lab equipment, sprinting down the corridor at 50 mph.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun vaults over burning lab equipment, sprinting down the corridor at 50 mph.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jalte hue prayogshala upkaranon par hamla karta hai, galiyare mein 50 meal prati ghante ki gati se daudta hai.

panels.shot: severed blast door at stairwell entrance
panels.action: A foot-thick titanium security door sheared clean off its hinges by terrifying claw marks.
panels.prose_en: A foot-thick titanium security door sheared clean off its hinges by terrifying claw marks.
panels.prose_hi: Ek fut-mote titanium suraksha darvaje ke panje ke daravane nishanon ne uske kabje ko saaf kar diya.

panels.shot: ha-jun inspecting the claw marks on steel
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the claw indentations: 'Yeh crawler ke marks nahi hain... Yeh humanoid claw marks hain.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh marks... Bhai ke stasis chamber se nikalne ke baad ke hain?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches the claw indentations: 'Yeh crawler ke marks nahi hain... Yeh humanoid claw marks hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun panje ke nishanon ko chhuta hai: 'ye croller ke nishan nahin han... yeh humanoid panje ke nishan han.'

panels.shot: leaping down 4 stories through central stairwell
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps straight down through the open central stairwell spiral, dropping four levels in seconds.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leaps straight down through the open central stairwell spiral, dropping four levels in seconds.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khule kendriya sidhi sarpil ke madhyam se sidhe neeche chhalang lagata hai, aur second mein char star gira deta hai.

panels.shot: landing before sub-level 7 vault door
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands outside the reinforced blast door labelled 'VAULT 09: SOVEREIGN SPECIMEN WING'.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands outside the reinforced blast door labelled 'VAULT 09: SOVEREIGN SPECIMEN WING'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun 'volt 09: Sovereign specimen ving' label wale prabalit blast darvaje ke bahar utarta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun swiping captain baek master card
panels.action: Ha-Jun swipes the titanium Level-10 card; the hydraulic locks release with a deep pneumatic hiss.

dialogue.text:
[CLEARANCE VERIFIED: LEVEL-10 OVERRIDE]
Welcome, Director Baek.
Unsealing Stasis Vault 09.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun swipes the titanium Level-10 card; the hydraulic locks release with a deep pneumatic hiss.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun titanium leval-10 card swipe karta hai; hydraulic taale ek gahri vayviy fusfusahat ke saath nikalte han.

panels.shot: massive circular vault doors parting
panels.action: Two interlocking half-ton steel doors grind apart, releasing clouds of cryogenic nitrogen fog.
panels.prose_en: Two interlocking half-ton steel doors grind apart, releasing clouds of cryogenic nitrogen fog.
panels.prose_hi: Do interlocking aadha ton steel ke darvaje alag ho jaate han, jisse cryogenic nitrogen kohre ke badal nikalte han.

panels.shot: sub-level 7 stasis chamber reveal
panels.action: A freezing, circular chamber lit by pale cyan floor tubes, frost coating every surface.
panels.prose_en: A freezing, circular chamber lit by pale cyan floor tubes, frost coating every surface.
panels.prose_hi: Halke siyan farsh tubon se prakashit ek thanda, golakar kaksh, har satah par thandh ki parat.

panels.shot: center stasis pod shattered from inside
panels.action: In the dead center stands the primary cryo-pod: the 4-inch bulletproof glass is blown outward from within.
panels.prose_en: In the dead center stands the primary cryo-pod: the 4-inch bulletproof glass is blown outward from within.
panels.prose_hi: Mrit kendra mein prathmik crio-pod khada hai: 4 inch ka bulletproof glass bhitar se bahar ki or uda hua hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun rushing to the empty pod with racing heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun grips the frosted metal frame of the empty pod: 'Khaali hai... Pod khali hai!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhai zinda hain! Unhone khud ise toda!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grips the frosted metal frame of the empty pod: 'Khaali hai... Pod khali hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun khali pod ke frosted metal frame ko pakadta hai: 'khali hai... pod khali hai!'.

panels.shot: frost-covered monitor terminal beside pod
panels.action: The stasis log display shows: 'AWAKENING STATUS: 100%. TIME OF BREACH: 30 MINUTES AGO'.
panels.prose_en: The stasis log display shows: 'AWAKENING STATUS: 100%. TIME OF BREACH: 30 MINUTES AGO'.
panels.prose_hi: Stacis log display dikhata hai: 'jagriti sthiti: 100%. ullanghan ka samay: 30 minute pahle'.

panels.shot: frosty bare footprints leading to back wall
panels.action: A trail of glowing crimson footprints pressed into the frozen floor leads directly to the back of the chamber.
panels.prose_en: A trail of glowing crimson footprints pressed into the frozen floor leads directly to the back of the chamber.
panels.prose_hi: Jame hue farsh mein dabae gaye chamakte lal rang ke pairon ke nishan ka ek nishan sidhe kaksh ke peeche ki or jata hai.

panels.shot: colossal dimensional rift in the back wall
panels.action: The back concrete wall has been torn into a 30-foot swirling vortex of pure obsidian and violet abyssal space.
panels.prose_en: The back concrete wall has been torn into a 30-foot swirling vortex of pure obsidian and violet abyssal space.
panels.prose_hi: Pichhe ki concrete ki deewar ko shuddh obsidian aur baingani gahre antriksh ke 30 foot ke ghumte bhanwar mein tod diya gaya hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing on broken pod rim
panels.action: Kuro stares into the swirling dimensional vortex: 'Tae-Jun is gate ke us paar gaya hai... Demon Realm mein.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Usne human world ko chhod kar Abyss mein qadam rakha hai. Tumhara intezaar kar raha hoga.

panels.prose_en: Kuro stares into the swirling dimensional vortex: 'Tae-Jun is gate ke us paar gaya hai... Demon Realm mein.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ghumte hue aayami bhanwar mein ghurta hai: 'Tae-Jun is gate ke us paar gaya hai... danav kshetra men.'

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping up to the swirling vortex
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands at the edge of the dimensional rift, violet lightning reflecting in his dual crimson-ringed eyes.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Toh phir... Demon Realm chalte hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands at the edge of the dimensional rift, violet lightning reflecting in his dual crimson-ringed eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aayami daraar ke kinare par khada hai, uski dohri lal-anguthi wali aankhon mein baingani bijli pratibimbit ho rahi hai.
